sub_strands.name: Approximations, Accuracy, and Taxes
performance_indicators: Determine absolute, relative, and percentage errors in mathematical calculations.
Compute personal income tax calculations using standard progressive tax bracket tables.
Solve advanced problems involving compound depreciation and real estate valuations.

sub_strands.name: Quadratic Expressions and Statistical Dispersion
performance_indicators: Expand and factorize quadratic expressions containing up to two variables smoothly.
Calculate measures of dispersion including the range, mean deviation, and variance for grouped datasets.
Represent complex data probabilities using multi-stage tree diagrams.

sub_strands.name: Circle Theorems and Trigonometric Ratios
performance_indicators: Investigate and apply angle properties of a circle, including angles subtended by the same arc.
Define and apply sine, cosine, and tangent ratios to solve right-angled triangle elevation puzzles.
Construct scale drawings to determine actual bearings and distances between multiple vector nodes.

sub_strands.name: Critical Critiques and Panel Discussions
performance_indicators: Evaluate oral reports critically, identifying logical fallacies, emotional manipulation, and rhetorical devices.
Participate in panel discussions, synthesizing peer inputs while defending complex arguments using precise register.

sub_strands.name: Comparative Literature and Advanced Set Texts
performance_indicators: Contrast structural stylistic elements across two distinct literary genres or cultural set texts.
Analyze subtext, satire, and underlying socio-political commentary inside poetry anthologies.

sub_strands.name: Argumentative Writing and Complex Syntaxes
performance_indicators: Incorporate conditional clauses and subjunctive moods to elevate stylistic clarity within written compositions.
Draft comprehensive, well-researched argumentative essays and formal reports following standard citation patterns.

sub_strands.name: Uchambuzi wa Semi na Midahalo
performance_indicators: Kutathmini semi mbalimbali (vielezi, mshangao, lakabu) zinazotumiwa katika hotuba za kitaifa.
Kuongoza mdahalo wa shule kwa kutumia kanuni za kidemokrasia na itifaki za kileksika za lugha sanifu.

sub_strands.name: Uchambuzi wa Riwaya na Ushairi
performance_indicators: Kusoma na kulinganisha dhamira kuu na usawiri wa wahusika katika riwaya mbili tofauti.
Kufafanua bahari mbalimbali za ushairi wa kimapokeo (kwa mfano, tarbia, tathnia) kwa kina.

sub_strands.name: Insha za Kitaaluma na Miundo Changamano
performance_indicators: Kuandika insha za kitaaluma, ripoti za kiuchunguzi, na kumbukumbu za mikutano changamano kwa muundo sahihi.
Kutumia sentensi mseto na vishazi (tegemezi na huru) kwa usahihi wa kisarufi katika uandishi.

sub_strands.name: Periodic Table, Bonding, and Acids
performance_indicators: Determine atomic numbers, mass numbers, and electron configurations for the first 20 elements.
Explain ionic and covalent bonding structures using standard dot-and-cross model diagrams.
Investigate properties of salt preparations via standard acid-base neutralization lab work safely.

sub_strands.name: Reproductive Systems and Basic Inheritance
performance_indicators: Illustrate human reproductive systems, detailing hormonal cycles, fertilization, and developmental phases.
Differentiate between mitosis and meiosis division stages and solve basic genetic monohybrid crosses.

sub_strands.name: Electromagnetic Induction and Sound Waves
performance_indicators: Demonstrate electromagnetic induction principles using moving magnets and copper coils cleanly.
Investigate variables affecting the speed, frequency, and pitch reflection of longitudinal sound waves.

sub_strands.name: Isometric Drawings and Electronic Circuits
performance_indicators: Construct precise three-dimensional isometric projections of compound wooden or metal joints.
Assemble simple electronic tracks incorporating resistors, capacitors, and diodes on breadboards safely.
Diagnose minor operational faults in basic household mechanical systems using multi-meters.

sub_strands.name: Web Architecture and Advanced Automation
performance_indicators: Develop basic, accessible static webpages utilizing structured HTML5 tags and CSS styling properties.
Write modular computer scripts featuring loops and functions to automate small digital tasks.

sub_strands.name: Financial Statements and Audits
performance_indicators: Draft standard income statements and statements of financial position (balance sheets) for sole proprietorships.
Interpret basic gross profit and net profit margin ratios to determine operational business viability.

sub_strands.name: Irrigation Systems and Cash Crops
performance_indicators: Design and model mini overhead or sprinkler irrigation systems tailored to specific topographical contours.
Execute post-harvest processing, sorting, and storage steps for commercial cash crops.
Apply integrated pest management (IPM) practices combining biological and structural controls.

sub_strands.name: Cattle Husbandry and Dairy Processing
performance_indicators: Outline standard feeding, milking, and disease prevention layouts for domestic dairy cattle.
Demonstrate value addition procedures by processing raw milk into yogurt or cheese hygienically.

sub_strands.name: Catering Operations and Kitchen Safety
performance_indicators: Plan, balance, and cost institutional menus catering to diverse nutritional and therapeutic groups.
Demonstrate advanced safety controls to combat major gas leaks or electrical hazards in commercial kitchens.

sub_strands.name: World Climatic Zones and Global Trade Networks
performance_indicators: Analyze factors governing world climatic configurations and their link to human economic adaptations.
Evaluate the impact of globalization, trade imbalances, and international monetary alliances on developing nations.
Read and interpret professional GIS, topographic, and political global world maps accurately.

sub_strands.name: Decolonization and International Organizations
performance_indicators: Examine the main pathways, conflicts, and internal adjustments that led to African national independence movements.
Evaluate the structural roles and achievements of the United Nations (UN) and African Union (AU) in peacekeeping.
Analyze constitutional amendment protocols and devloved administrative frameworks within the Kenyan context.

sub_strands.name: Global Citizenship and Conflict Transformation
performance_indicators: Formulate actionable local strategies to address global issues such as climate change and migration.
Apply non-violent conflict transformation models to resolve structural problems inside local institutions.

sub_strands.name: Digital Photography and Industrial Design
performance_indicators: Capture and edit digital photographs applying professional framing rule-of-thirds and lighting parameters.
Design and construct functional packaging prototypes using sustainable materials for local commercial items.
Execute multi-layered print media compositions using digital or manual stencil matrices cleanly.

sub_strands.name: Four-Part Harmonies and Musical Production
performance_indicators: Arrange and sing four-part western or traditional choral phrases observing exact voice assignments.
Produce, block, and stage a comprehensive multi-act theater performance focusing on regional equity values.

sub_strands.name: Advanced Athletics Tactics and Event Management
performance_indicators: Apply pacing and recovery tactics during middle-distance races and execute perfect pole vault clearances safely.
Organize and officiate internal school tournament draws using standard league or knockout brackets.

sub_strands.name: Eschatology, Parables, and Community Integrity
performance_indicators: Analyze biblical insights regarding eschatology and apply lessons on readiness to daily ethical choices.
Deconstruct the radical socio-economic fairness demands within New Testament parables on wealth and stewardship.
Demonstrate unyielding institutional accountability when leading community or peer support groups.

sub_strands.name: Quranic Jurisprudence and Ethical Leadership
performance_indicators: Translate, interpret, and apply specific civic rulings embedded in Surah Al-Hujurat and Surah An-Nur.
Examine major legal guidelines concerning ethical leadership and anti-corruption profiles in Islamic history.
Practice impartial equity, restorative justice, and inclusive peace-building within institutional peer networks.
